Turn assigns -facing_dir times the configured speed only in profile 0, requests state 3 with flags 2, then reverses facing. Animation ID 2 comes from the table. Directional wording describes the configured-speed behavior; the inherited parameter-domain uncertainty remains applicable.

State 6 repeats animation on the original Patapata and invokes removal on qualifying collision. Conversion separately obtains new_gobj and transfers fields to its Nokonoko data.

Thrown entry resets the original actor's counters and selects state 6. Its registered callbacks provide animation repetition, common falling physics and impact removal, independently of the successor lifecycle.
